operators.shape: verdict + the numbers the rule used + the stated rule text
operators.template: python template per rule id (table below)

gap_type.rule: gap up if open > prev_close*1.01; gap down if open < prev_close*0.99; else flat

breakout.rule: close >= max(close, prior lookback) and volume >= 1.5 * mean(volume, lookback)
breakout.inputs: close above the window maximum on volume

distribution_absorption.rule: absorption if delivery_pct z > 2 and return >= 0; distribution if delivery_pct z > 2 and return < 0
distribution_absorption.inputs: delivery spikes with or without price progress

margin_bottom.rule: verdict 'bottomed' if the claim direction is up after >= 2 consecutive periods of falling margin

control_change.rule: control change if any holder_class moves >= 5 percentage points in one quarter, or promoter_pct falls >= 5pp

solvency.rule: fail if promoter pledge > 15% or interest coverage < 2.5x or D/E > 1.5x

valuation_premium.rule: premium if pb > median(pb of the peer set) * 1.2
valuation_premium.inputs: premium to peers on the same measure

receivables_quality.rule: deteriorating if dso rises while revenue growth <= 0, or dso rises > 20% and cfo/revenue falls
receivables_quality.inputs: is the book worth face value

say_vs_do.rule: credible if the guided direction held in >= 70% of tested periods; the score is the hit rate with n
say_vs_do.inputs: management credibility on its own guidance

regime_break.rule: broken if the out-of-sample coefficient sign flips or |t| < 2 in the later window
regime_break.inputs: did a measured link stop working

analog_cycle.rule: top-k by standardised distance over the shared window; k=5, no hindsight on the target window
analog_cycle.inputs: closest past cycle on the same atoms

dilution.rule: dilutive if share_count growth > pat growth + 5pp over the window
dilution.inputs: share count growing faster than the business

golden_cross.rule: golden cross if sma_50 crosses above sma_200 in the window; death cross if it crosses below

support_resistance.rule: support = the highest low of the last 60 sessions below the close; resistance = the lowest high of the last 60 above the close; a 'real' level needs >= 2 touches within 1%
